page.overview:
Who is Che'ri?

Che'ri was a Force-sensitive Chiss female who served as an ozyly-esehembo within the Chiss Ascendancy. Thalias was her caregiver, or "Momish" while she served on Mitth'raw'nuruodo's ship. She liked to draw on her questis and later with colored graph markers. She often drew pictures of birds, flashflies, and scenery as seen from above, as she had always dreamed of flying. Che'ri often had nightmares, which was typical of sky-walkers. She understood the trade language of Meese Caulf.

Che'ri was born around 29 BBY. At a young age, she was determined to have Third Sight, and was made part of the Chiss Sky-walker corps.

She served on multiple ships, with eight caregivers, until she fell under service to Mitth'raw'nuruodo, core name "Thrawn," aboard his ship, the Springhawk. Che'ri was sprawled across a chair making drawings/collages of pre-existing assets in her questis when her new caregiver, Mitth'ali'astov ("Thalias") arrived. Instead of introducing herself right away, Thalias, not wanting to overwhelm Che'ri, went to her private quarters to settle in. However, after a while, Thalias introduces herself and compliments Che'ri's artwork, describing it as a talent to be cherished. Che'ri reflects upon how her previous caregivers found her artwork to be "silly". Che'ri is surprised to learn that Thalias had been a sky-walker (with only four caregivers). The two talk about the incompetencies of the operation of the sky-walker/caregiver system. Eventually, Che'ri is concerned about going into a battle, but Thalias tries to soothe her by reassuring Senior Captain Thrawn's military prowess. Thalias asks Che'ri if she would like to read about Thrawn's military career. Che'ri refuses, citing her dislike of reading, but Thalias sends the file to her questis anyway. Che'ri complains about the file being too long, to which Thalias promises to create an abridged version at a later time.

After a battle over the Paataatus Hiveborn homeworld of Nettehi, Che'ri brought the Springhawk out of hyperspace in an unknown system. Che'ri was starting to feel an overload spell, but did not say any anything about it, due to being taught to not show weakness. She silently hoped that Thrawn would allow her to take a break from her duties. To her surprise, Thrawn allowed her to rest. Che'ri, while relieved, was disturbed at the thought of Thrawn knowing of Che'ri's need for a break. Thrawn orders the helm officer, Lieutenant Commander Tumaz'mor'diamir ("Azmordi") to bring the Springhawk into a high orbit over the system's planet. As Azmordi took control of the ship, Che'ri became fascinated with the ship's controls. Che'ri overheard Thalias thanking Thrawn for stopping the ship, recognizing that she too knew of Che'ri's coming overload spell. She wondered if everybody knew.
